user.title: Add a target
user.description: Give the target a name you will use in dashboards and scripts. Supply a MAC to follow it wherever DHCP moves it, or an IP/hostname to seed it — with 'Follow MAC' on, the MAC is learned on first contact and used from then on.

data_description.consider_home: Grace period before a silent target is reported away. Rides out Wi-Fi power save.
data_description.subnet: Left empty, the /24 around the last known address is used.

error.need_host_or_mac: Provide an IP/hostname, a MAC address, or both.
error.invalid_mac: That does not look like a MAC address.

abort.already_configured: This target is already set up.

ping.name: Ping
ping.description: Check a target immediately, without waiting for the next poll, and return the result.

target.name: Target
target.description: Name of the target to check. Omit to check every target.

refresh_table.name: Refresh neighbour table
refresh_table.description: Re-read the MAC-to-IP table and return it.

sweep.name: Sweep first
sweep.description: Ping the subnet to repopulate the table before reading it.
